definitions.explanation: To greet or receive someone or something with pleasure and hospitality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歓迎|かんげい}する。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}かく→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{歓迎|かんげい}した。
examples.english: We warmly welcomed the new members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歓迎|かんげい}する⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The government showed a stance of welcoming investment from overseas.

notes:
Used both for welcoming people (guests, visitors, new members) and for welcoming abstract things (proposals, changes, investment). The noun form ⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧ is very common in signs and announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧: welcome party
- ⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: words of welcome
- ⟦{大歓迎|だいかんげい}→大歓迎：16423_daikangei⟧: very welcome; a big welcome
- ⟦ようこそ→ようこそ：27879_youkoso⟧: welcome (greeting) — often paired with ⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧
- ⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧⟦ムード→ムード：11160_muudo⟧: welcoming atmosphere

USAGE:
The expression ⟦{大歓迎|だいかんげい}→大歓迎：16423_daikangei⟧ (greatly welcome) is frequently used in casual conversation to express strong approval: ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦{大歓迎|だいかんげい}→大歓迎：16423_daikangei⟧ (beginners very welcome).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to go to meet; to welcome — more neutral; focuses on the physical act of receiving someone
- ⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧: to entertain; to treat hospitably — emphasizes providing food, drink, or entertainment
- ⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept; to take in — focuses on acceptance, less on warmth
